events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether delivery commits are pushed
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin main 2>&1 | tail -2; for c in 3d7c62a2 a7d83a00; do git merge-base --is-ancestor $c origin/main && echo "$c in origin/main" || echo "$c NOT in origin"; done; git log --oneline origin/main..main | head; git log --oneline -3 origin/main; git log --oneline --format='%h %s' -8 -- cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts cloud/src/settings.ts | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read live delivery status, reminders, Adi test attendee

events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py GET /admin/api/attendees > /tmp/t033_att.txt 2>&1; wc -c /tmp/t033_att.txt; grep -n -i -B3 -A12 '"Adi test"' /tmp/t033_att.txt | grep -iE '"(id|name|email|test|whatsapp|created_at|source|phone)"' | head -20; sed -n 1,30p workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py | grep -n -iE 'trunc|limit|\[:'

events.name: Bash

events.head: List all Adi test attendees and WhatsApp fields

events.name: Grep
events.head: /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/src/index.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find admin route exposing attendee WhatsApp
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && grep -rn "whatsapp" cloud/src/index.ts | head -8; grep -rln "attendees/:id\|/admin/api/attendee" cloud/src | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read-only check which attendees have a WhatsApp number
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && npx wrangler d1 execute $(grep -m1 -oE 'database_name *= *"[^"]+"' wrangler.toml | cut -d'"' -f2) --remote --json --command "SELECT id, name, test, revoked, whatsapp IS NOT NULL AS has_wa FROM attendees WHERE whatsapp IS NOT NULL OR (test=1 AND name LIKE '%Adi%')" 2>&1 | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d[0]['results'])" 2>&1 | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find wrangler config and DB name
events.input: $ ls wrangler.* ; grep -m2 -E 'database_name|"name"' wrangler.json* 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read-only WhatsApp presence check and live Worker version
events.input: $ npx wrangler d1 execute revops-centre --remote --json --command "SELECT id, name, test, revoked, whatsapp IS NOT NULL AS has_wa FROM attendees WHERE whatsapp IS NOT NULL OR (test=1 AND name LIKE '%Adi%')" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d[0]['results'])"; npx wrangler deployments list 2>/dev/null | tail -6 | grep -iE 'version|created'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm deployed build includes delivery commits
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && git merge-base --is-ancestor a7d83a00 8eb66895 && echo "a7d83a00 in deployed 8eb66895"; git diff --stat 8eb66895 origin/main -- cloud/src cloud/migrations cloud/wrangler.jsonc | tail -3

events.text: The live Worker already carries the delivery commits; now rerunning both probes locally.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe usage header
events.input: $ sed -n 1,25p app/scripts/probe-day-delivery.mjs | grep -E '^//|^ \*|CENTRE|BASE|env\.' | head -15

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how to start simulator and local centre
events.input: $ sed -n 25,45p app/scripts/probe-day-delivery.mjs | grep -E '^ \*|^//' | head -12; ls app/scripts | grep -iE 'sim|vendor' | head; grep -n "8893\|8961" workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-033.json 2>/dev/null | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find simulator script and past local centre command
events.input: $ grep -rln "8893" app/scripts cloud/scripts scripts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -o 'wrangler dev[^"]\{0,160\}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-033.json 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -3; grep -o 'node [^ "]*sim[^"]\{0,80\}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-033.json 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate simulator implementation
events.input: $ ls workshop-plan/tasks/activity/ | grep T-033; grep -rlE "vendor.?sim|simulator" --include=*.mjs --include=*.js --include=*.py --include=*.sh app/scripts cloud scripts workshop-plan/ops 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find simulator and past run commands
events.input: $ grep -rlE "simulator" app/scripts cloud/scripts scripts workshop-plan/ops 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | grep -vE '\.db$|dryrun/' | head; python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find simulator file and probe env usage
events.input: $ ls app/scripts cloud/scripts scripts 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'sim|fake|mock' ; grep -n "SIM\b\|SIM=\|TANTRA_BASE\|wrangler" app/scripts/probe-day-delivery.mjs | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read vendor simulator usage
events.input: $ ls scripts/vendor-sim.py 2>/dev/null || find . -name vendor-sim.py -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | head -2; F=$(find . -name vendor-sim.py -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | head -1); sed -n 1,30p $F | grep -iE 'usage|port|python|TANTRA|wrangler|var' | head -12

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read simulator docstring and Tantra base var
events.input: $ sed -n 2,40p cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | grep -vE '^(import|from) ' | head -30; ls cloud/.dev.vars* 2>/dev/null; grep -n "TANTRA_API_BASE\|TANTRA_BASE\|tantra_base" cloud/src/*.ts | head -4

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check probe admin key source and SIM_URL wiring
events.input: $ grep -n "ADMIN\|dev.vars\|admin_key\|x-admin" app/scripts/probe-day-delivery.mjs | head -5; grep -n "SIM_URL" cloud/wrangler.jsonc cloud/src/*.ts | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start simulator and fresh local centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && lsof -ti:8961,8893 | head; P=/tmp/t033-persist-$$; echo $P > /tmp/t033-persist; SIM_STATE=/tmp/t033-sim.json SIM_PORT=8893 nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py > /tmp/t033-sim.log 2>&1 & echo SIMPID $!; npx wrangler d1 migrations apply revops-centre --local --persist-to $P 2>&1 | tail -1; nohup npx wrangler dev --port 8961 --persist-to $P --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8893 > /tmp/t033-dev.log 2>&1 & echo DEVPID $!

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for local centre and run both probes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8961/ 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^[1-5]' && break; command sleep 2 2>/dev/null || python3 -c 'import time;time.sleep(2)'; done; tail -2 /tmp/t033-dev.log; CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8961 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8893 node app/scripts/probe-day-delivery.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4; CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8961 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8893 node app/scripts/probe-output-delivery.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4

events.text: Both probes pass; counting results, stopping the servers, and checking T-408/T-419 status.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Count passes, stop servers, read input task states
events.input: $ CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8961 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8893 node app/scripts/probe-day-delivery.mjs 2>&1 | grep -cE '^PASS'; kill 41072 41145 2>/dev/null; pkill -P 41145 2>/dev/null; true; python3 -c "
